Corridor #5 - (Recommended Corridor for project construction) is a revision of Corridor #3, adjusted to accommodate the construction of a new air cargo area at General Mitchell Field. It was the result of coordinated efforts by Airport Officials, Milwaukee County, Federal Aviation Administration, and the Division of Highways to be compatible with the adopted long range Master Plan for the expansion of facilities at General Mitchell Field.
This corridor is coincident with Corridor #3 from its interchange location at I-94 easterly to a point just west of the C.M. St. P. & P. Railroad. For discussion of Corridor #5 that section will be repeated here.
Corridor #5 begins at its westerly end from an interchange located approximately midway between Ramsey Avenue and Grange Avenue.
This freeway access interchange to the Interstate

System at I-94 would be located 3/4 miles north of the College

Avenue interchange and 1-1/4 miles south of the directional interchange at Layton Avenue. At the present time an interchange constructed in this vicinity would be virtually free of development. The area west of I-94, to accommodate a portion of the interchange, is undeveloped lands with an open 100 foot wide Oak Creek storm water drainage channel running diagonally across it.
